name: Mastodon
description: Post to a Mastodon account, read its home timeline, and search public posts on its server.
intentHints: search mastodon for mentions of us
_authNote: Mastodon is federated: every server is its own OAuth provider with its own authorize and token URLs, which the platform's OAuth config cannot express (its endpoints are static per integration). A token the user issues on their own server is one screen for them and avoids registering an application on every instance that exists.

credentialFields.label: Server
credentialFields.help: The full URL of your Mastodon server, including https://.
credentialFields.patternHelp: The full server URL including https://, like https://mastodon.social.

credentialFields.label: Access token
credentialFields.help: On your server: Preferences → Development → New application. Tick read and write, then copy the access token.

providedTools.description: Publish a post. `visibility` is public, unlisted, private or direct, and defaults to public. Set `spoiler_text` to put the post behind a content warning.
The connected account's home timeline: posts from the accounts it follows.
Search posts on the connected server. Federated search only reaches posts that server already knows about, so results are narrower than searching Mastodon as a whole.
